definitions.explanation: A public march by a group of people to express opposition to or support for a political or social cause.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧デモ{行進|こうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A demonstration march was held in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {数千人|すうせんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧デモ{行進|こうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: Several thousand citizens participated in the demonstration march.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境問題|かんきょうもんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧デモ{行進|こうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{世界各地|せかいかくち}→世界各地：24526_sekaikakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われ→行う：01238_okonau⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げた→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: Demonstration marches against environmental issues were held simultaneously around the world, and many young people raised their voices.

notes:
A compound of ⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧ (short for デモンストレーション, demonstration) and ⟦{行進|こうしん}→行進：22196_koushin⟧ (marching). In Japan, demonstrations typically require advance notification to the police and follow designated routes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- デモ{行進|こうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold a demonstration march
- デモ{行進|こうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to participate in a march
- ⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧なデモ{行進|こうしん}: large-scale demonstration
- {平和的|へいわてき}なデモ{行進|こうしん}: peaceful march

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧: demonstration (abbreviation, often used alone)
- ⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧: protest
- ⟦{集会|しゅうかい}→集会：14654_shuukai⟧: rally; gathering
- ⟦{行進|こうしん}→行進：22196_koushin⟧: march; parade
